_status: READY — FFmpeg command in implementation_plan below
_law: Semantic absorption over loudness. Music is not decoration. It occupies the cognitive space that narration has vacated.
mix_philosophy: semantic absorption over loudness — music sub-perceptual under narration, surfaces during intentional silence, claims the visual tail
_timing_source: Derived from last assemble-audio.ts run (2026-07-06). ElevenLabs timestamps are TTS-synthesis-specific — re-derive from breathing_points if VO is re-synthesized.

narration_envelope.note: Narration occupies 0-28.24s (words) + breathing silence distributed within that window. Breathed audio track ends at 31.2s. 31.2-38.25s is pure visual.

regions.narration: You do not choose against yourself.
regions.note: Track intro is near-silent by nature (RMS ~-63 dB at s0). Music barely audible — correct. Void establishes itself.
First breath. Viewer receives 'You do not choose against yourself.' Music surfaces briefly.
Two-word sentence. Heaviest semantic weight of S1. Duck music — nothing competes.
Longest S1 silence. Track is now entering its -50 dB RMS range (s8-s10). Music audible but ambient.
Accumulation beat. Fragmentation structure carries semantic weight — music stays quiet.
Brief rise between 'minor.' and 'Rational.' Mirrors fragmentation rhythm in music.

regions.narration: Survivable. Until surrender feels rational. You are not wrong to feel it. You are wrong about what it means.
regions.note: S3 pivot area. Music at lowest level — this section demands maximum cognitive attention. 'You are wrong about what it means.' requires nothing competing with it.

PRIMARY RISE EVENT. The correction has landed. This is where cognition begins. Music emerges to hold the space while the viewer processes. Track is now at ~-43 dB RMS naturally — music audibly present for the first time.
Slightly less ducked than S3 — energy state has shifted post-pivot. Ignition is approaching.
Fragment held. Music rises to maintain tension before resolution.

regions.narration: is the only moment the fire begins.
regions.note: Resolution line. Music slightly more present — the doctrine's central claim deserves the music to have already arrived.
SECONDARY RISE EVENT. The reel's central claim has landed. 1.2 seconds of music-supported space. Track energy is building (approaching -35 dB RMS). Music audible and emotional.
Final line. Music slightly more present — voice is completing, music is taking over.

regions.narration: [final decay — narration ends, breathing audio fades]
regions.note: Voice has ended. Music surfaces. Track is now at its most energetic section (~-35 dB RMS). Appropriate — the doctrine has been delivered, music owns the emotional residue.
Visual tail. New cold surface appears. Music is the only signal — this is the highest music presence in the reel. Track is at peak natural energy here.
Begin fade. The cold surface is waiting. Music recedes — viewer exits into silence.
Near silence. Reel ends into void.

primary_rise.reason: Post-pivot reflection window. Correction has landed. This is where the viewer's cognition begins. Music holds the space.

secondary_rise.reason: Post-ignition dwell. The reel's central claim has landed. 1.2 seconds of music-supported emotional space.

visual_tail_claim.reason: Narration has ended. Visuals are the only storytellers. Music is at its most prominent.

final_dissolve.reason: Möbius close. The next surface is already waiting. Music dissolves as the visual does.

attention_allocation.note: Attention is a finite resource. The mix allocates it using music_priority as the inverse of voice_priority.
attention_allocation.at: S3 pivot approach — 'You are wrong about what it means.' demands 92% of attention
Visual tail — narration has ended, music owns 100%
attention_allocation.philosophy: Music never competes for cognitive resources that narration needs. Music fills cognitive space that narration has vacated.

At 22.65s: rise to -18dB over 0.3s. Hold until 23.85s. Return to -30dB at 23.85s
